name: inside-the-organization

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 preview
scripts.dev:tiktok: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 preview tiktok
scripts.lint: npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 lint && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 lint tiktok
scripts.check: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 check
scripts.check:tiktok: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 check tiktok
scripts.render: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 render -f 30 -q looks -o renders/mcdonalds-inside-the-organization.mp4
scripts.render:tiktok: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.143 render tiktok -f 30 -q looks -o renders/mcdonalds-inside-the-organization-tiktok.mp4
scripts.music: python3 scripts/music.py && ffmpeg -y -i assets/audio/music.wav -b:a 192k assets/audio/music.mp3 && rm assets/audio/music.wav

description: McDonald's — Inside the Organization : vidéo explicative en motion design 3D isométrique (Hyperframes + Three.js)
